out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided clearly at handwashing sink next to 3-compartment sink used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Please provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: vada (cooked potato) at 46F, unsalted butter at 59F, yogurt at 53F in 2 DR prep cooler (50F); unsalted butter at 54F, cooked vegetables at 53F, cut Paneer cheese at 55F in 1 DR UPR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded all aforementioned TCS food items from 2 DR prep cooler and 1 DR UPR refrigerator.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the delivery door. Observed light coming through the back delivery door.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EHS discussed with PIC repairing the seal of the delivery door. Please provide repairs to the delivery door seal. Chaatwala (Inspection Date: 05/28/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DR prep cooler at 50F and 1 DR UPR refrigerator at 55F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC agreed to discontinue use of refrigeration units. PIC contacted technician during inspection.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: PIC obtained a bleach test kit during inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the faucet of the 3-compartment sink is leaking.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Please repair the leaking faucet of the 3-compartment sink to prevent plumbing issues and maintain the sink in good repair.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cooked white rice in the rice warmer at 128F after 2hr.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC reheated the cooked white rice to 165F and placed it into the rice warmer, which maintains 135F or above.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles with different varieties of sauces throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled aforementioned squeeze bottles during the inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives, forks, or spoons were not stored in containers at the back kitchen with the handles up.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. PiC cleaned, sanitized and placed all utensils with lip-contact surface facing down.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: milk at 48F, cut Panner cheese at 48F in 1 DR UPR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC relocated TCS food items (milk, cut Paneer cheese), which had been stored in the cooler for no more than 4 hours, to another unit maintaining the proper temperature.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked lentils, cooked chickpeas and etc.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS discussed date marking with management. All food sitting under refrigeration for more than 24 hours requires labels with dates. PIC labeled the food items during the inspection for compliance.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: working containers of salt, sugar, pepper, squeeze bottles of oil and vinegar stored on cook line and throughout establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled the food items during the inspection for compliance. Chaatwala (Inspection Date: 07/01/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed cups without handle using as a dispensing utensils inside the bulk containers of rice, chickpeas, lentils and etc.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed the cups from bulk containers and understands dispensing utensils should have a handle if stored inside food items.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no quaternary ammonia test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions from sanitizer dispenser.
violations.corrective_action: PIC purchased quarterly ammonia test kit during the inspection.

violations.title: Availability of Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There are no chemical sanitizers for sanitizing equipment and utensils available in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Except for those that are generated on-site, at the time of use, chemical sanitizers that are used to sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. PIC purchased bleach and set up the sanitizing solution in the 3-compartment sink during the inspection.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. Observed a non-proved splitter attached to the faucet of the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. PIC agreed to purchase an approved splitter for the mop sink. PIC disconnected non-approved splitter from the faucet of mop sink.
